title: ERCIM “Alain Bensoussan” Fellowship Programme
about: ERCIM runs the “Alain Bensoussan” Fellowship Programme for PhD holders, with applications made online through fellowship.ercim.eu. The programme holds two calls a year; its official site lists the next application deadline as 30 April 2027.
